title: A Cloud-Accessible Open-Source Framework for the Electromagnetic Modelling of Applied Superconductors
summary: We present the H-cloud formalism, a cloud-accessible and open-source finite-element framework for electromagnetic modelling of applied superconductors. The proposed method expresses the nonlinear electromagnetic response of type-II superconductors in a curl-conforming discretisation based on Nédélec finite elements, where the tangential applied-field boundary condition, nonlinear E-J power law, and fully implicit time-discrete residual are stated explicitly at the variational level, all within a scripted Python finite-element workflow.
